properties.description: 2stac2 tool to transform Medslik result into a STAC
properties.name: 2stac2_medslik_pipeline
properties.cwl:
cwlVersion: v1.2
$namespaces:
  s: https://schema.org/
$graph:
- class: CommandLineTool
  id: 2stac2_medslik_pipeline
  baseCommand: python
  arguments:
  - /opt/2stac2.py
  - --file
  - valueFrom: "${\n  function findNetcdfFile(dir) {\n    if (dir.class === 'File'\
      \ && dir.basename.endsWith('.nc')) return dir.path;\n    if (dir.class === 'Directory'\
      \ && dir.listing) {\n      for (const f of dir.listing) {\n        const found\
      \ = findNetcdfFile(f);\n        if (found) return found;\n      }\n    }\n \
      \   return null;\n  }\n  const ncPath = findNetcdfFile(inputs.medslik_result);\n\
      \  if (!ncPath) throw new Error('No NetCDF file found in directory');\n  return\
      \ ncPath;\n}\n"
  - --metadata
  - valueFrom: $(runtime.outdir + '/multiple_metadata.json')
  inputs:
    medslik_result:
      doc: Medslik simulation result
      type: Directory
      loadListing: deep_listing
    metadata:
      doc: metadata file description
      type: File
      loadContents: true
  outputs:
    stac_result:
      outputBinding:
        glob: stac_result
      type: Directory
      doc: STAC output
  requirements:
    EnvVarRequirement:
      envDef:
        PATH: /opt/conda/envs/application/bin:/opt/conda/condabin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
    ResourceRequirement: {}
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}
    DockerRequirement:
      dockerPull: iliad-repository.inesctec.pt/2stac2:0.3.1
    InplaceUpdateRequirement:
      inplaceUpdate: true
    InitialWorkDirRequirement:
      listing: "${\n  const content = JSON.parse(inputs.metadata.contents);\n  const\
        \ metadata = [{...JSON.parse(inputs.metadata.contents), filename: 'spill_properties.nc'}];\n\
        \  return [{\"class\": \"File\", \"basename\": \"multiple_metadata.json\"\
        , \"contents\": JSON.stringify(metadata) }];\n}\n"
  s:name: 2stac2_medslik_pipeline
  s:softwareVersion: 0.3.1
  s:description: 2stac2 tool to transform Medslik result into a STAC
  s:keywords:
  - stac
  - metadata
  s:programmingLanguage: python
  s:producer:
    class: s:Organization
    s:name: INESCTEC
    s:url: https://inesctec.pt
    s:address:
      class: s:PostalAddress
      s:addressCountry: PT
  s:sourceOrganization:
  - class: s:Organization
    s:name: INESCTEC
    s:url: https://inesctec.pt
    s:address:
      class: s:PostalAddress
      s:addressCountry: PT
  s:author:
  - class: s:Person
    s:name: Miguel Correia
    s:email: miguel.r.correia@inesctec.pt
  s:dateCreated: '2026-01-27T16:00:40Z'
  s:identifier: urn:apkg:tool:inesctec:pt:2stac2_medslik_pipeline:0.3.1
  s:sdDatePublished: '2026-01-27T16:04:26.482232Z'
  s:sdPublisher:
    class: Organization
    name: Application Package Registry
    url: https://iliad-registry.inesctec.pt
